item.title: Baldwin High celebrates Signing Day
item.description: On Feb. 4, Baldwin High School hosted its National Letter of Intent (NLI) Signing Day celebration in the James A. Lunsford Gymnasium, honoring three student-athletes who officially committed to continue their academic and athletic careers at the collegiate level.

item.title: Missing woman found in Putnam Co. during winter storm
item.description: An Putnam County woman with Alzheimer’s walked away from a relative’s home last week and later died.

item.title: Century Bank and Trust promotes Dyer to Senior VP, Head of Operations
item.description: Century Bank and Trust recently announced the promotion of Tara Dyer to senior vice president, Head of Operations. In this role, Dyer will continue to oversee the bank’s operational functions, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and exceptional service across the organization.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Black History a part of tapestry of America
item.description: Dr. Carter G. Woodson set out in 1926 to provide a platform to recognize the often unknown and underacknowledged contributions of Black Americans during the second week in February, which coincides with Pres. Abraham Lincoln’s birthday and the birth of abolitionist, writer and freed slave Frederick Douglass.

item.title: Firefighters battle N. Jefferson Street fire
item.description: A large brick home on the 2000 block of North Jefferson Street in Baldwin County sustained extensive damages when fire broke out in a rear bedroom Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Authorities foil intended prison drop at Hancock State Prison
item.description: A man and woman have been arrested in connection with the seizure of a drone and illegal items believed to have been destined for Hancock State Prison near Sparta on Feb. 5, local authorities say.

item.title: VAN HORN: What makes you an interesting person?
item.description: If what makes a person interesting can be measured by the books they’ve read, the people they’ve met, the places they’ve traveled, the art they’ve admired, the mountains they’ve climbed, the marathons they’ve run, or the national parks they’ve walked through, then the answer is easy.

item.title: EDITORIAL: State must address issues in corrections system
item.description: A Hancock State prisoner dies after a beating in his cell. Four deaths were reported in less than a week at Washington State Prison. Five inmates injured at Hancock State Prison.
